Class MenuView

java.lang.Object
com.pos.MenuView
public class MenuView extends Object
Manager view for viewing, adding, and updating menu items. Displays the menu in a table backed by the menu_item table in PostgreSQL and provides an editor for changing an item's name, price, category, and availability.
Author:
Rafael Perez
